MERCHANT CASH ADVANCE AGREEMENT

This Merchant Cash Advance Agreement is entered into as of April 14, 2026 between Lone Mesa Capital LLC ("Funder") and Alvarado Auto Repair, Inc. ("Merchant").

1. Advance. Funder will pay Merchant $40,000. Merchant will pay Funder $56,000.

2. Payments. Merchant will pay Funder $560 on each business day until the full amount has been paid.

3. Confession of Judgment. Merchant irrevocably authorizes any attorney to appear for Merchant in any court and confess judgment against Merchant for the unpaid balance, without notice.

4. Personal Guaranty. Raul Alvarado, the owner of Merchant, unconditionally guarantees payment of all amounts Merchant owes under this Agreement.

5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

LONE MESA CAPITAL LLC

By: ______________________
Name: Greta Lund
Title: Manager

ALVARADO AUTO REPAIR, INC.
